name: 파일 구조 분석
description: Analyzes file naming patterns, resolution characteristics, aspect ratios, and bytes-per-pixel ratios to detect AI-generated images based on file-level characteristics. AI tools produce files with distinctive structural signatures.
mechanism:
The file structure analysis performs multi-dimensional pattern matching:

1. **File Naming Convention Analysis**: Examines filenames for AI-typical patterns (UUID strings, hash-based names like `image_00001.png`, `txt2img_xxx`, `comfyui_xxx`) vs camera-typical patterns (DSC_xxxx, IMG_xxxx, P1000xxx, DSCN_xxxx).

2. **Resolution Fingerprinting**: Matches image dimensions against known AI model output sizes (512×512, 768×768, 1024×1024, 2048×2048) and checks for multiples of 64 (VAE latent space alignment).

3. **Aspect Ratio Analysis**: Compares aspect ratios against standard camera sensor ratios (3:2, 4:3, 16:9) vs AI-typical ratios (1:1 square outputs).

4. **Bytes-per-Pixel Ratio**: Calculates file size relative to pixel count. AI-generated images often have different compression characteristics than camera captures.

5. **File Extension Consistency**: Validates that file extension matches actual format headers (magic bytes).
parameters:
AI 해상도: 512², 768², 1024², 2048²
VAE 정렬: 64의 배수
AI 패턴: UUID, hash, image_N, txt2img, comfyui
카메라 패턴: DSC, IMG, P, DSCN, GOPR, DJI
accuracy: Medium - 70-80%. Most effective combined with other metadata signals. High accuracy for unmodified AI outputs with original filenames.
source: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney 출력 포맷 분석
useCase: First-pass triage in AI detection workflows. Quickly identifies obvious AI-generated content based on file-level metadata before deeper pixel analysis. Useful for batch processing large image collections.
strengths:
• 매우 빠름 — 파일 메타데이터에서만 작동
• 일반적인 AI 도구 출력 감지
• 해상도 핑거프린팅이 매우 특이적
• 64의 배수 확인으로 VAE 기반 생성기 감지
• EXIF 데이터 없이도 작동
limitations:
• 파일 이름 변경이나 크기 조정으로 쉽게 우회 가능
• 많은 합법적 이미지가 1:1 비율 사용
• 소비자 카메라 해상도가 AI 출력과 겹침
• 후처리된 AI 이미지 감지 불가
• 새 도구 출현으로 패턴이 변화

references.title: Rombach, R. et al. (2022). High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models. CVPR 2022.
Ramesh, A. et al. (2022). Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents.
